name: backend-infra-pg-pydanticai-cookie
title: 后端基建 pg迁移+pydantic-ai+cookie鉴权
description: 后端基建任务。1) SQLite→PostgreSQL迁移：docker-compose起本地pg，SQLAlchemy改pg方言(JSONB存config/raw_payload/extracted_tables)，空库起步重新seed，上Alembic补baseline migration。2) 鉴权cookie化：/auth/login与/refresh改Set-Cookie(access+refresh, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/)，/refresh从cookie读refresh，/me从cookie读access，/logout清cookie。3) pydantic-ai基建：装pydantic-ai-slim[openai]，建agent工厂模块级单例(OpenAIChatModel+OpenAIProvider复用llm.base_url/model_name/api_key/timeout)，替换classifier/normalizer/portrait三个自写httpx调用，提示词逐字搬进instructions，output_type=Literal/list[FlowRecord]/DocumentPortrait，加output_validator兜底字段完整。4) 回归验证：固定输入跑normalizer，diff换框架前后标准化输出，验记录1:1+字段无丢。5) FastAPI挂frontend/dist静态+SPA fallback。落地严格遵循docs/research/pydantic-ai-conventions.md(v1.107.0规范)。验收：pg起得来、Alembic迁移可跑、cookie登录闭环、三个LLM模块输出与换框架前一致、前端静态可由后端同源服务。
creator: zhaozheng
